# Libraries
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(fs)
library(stringr)
```
# Synchronize video data
```{r}
# ----------------------------
# Paths
# ----------------------------
ROOT_DIR <- "/Users/evansalvarez/Eye-tracking-Loneliness-Mindwandering-ELM-/data"
FNIRS_DIR <- file.path(ROOT_DIR, "processed/fNIRS_processed_videos")
EYE_DIR   <- file.path(ROOT_DIR, "processed/eye_processed_videos")
QC_DIR <- file.path(ROOT_DIR, "qc/sync")
OUT_DIR <- file.path(ROOT_DIR, "processed/eye_sync_fNIRS_videos")

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
normalize_id <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%02d", as.integer(x))
}

extract_eye_id <- function(path) {
  m <- str_match(basename(path), "^(\\d+)_")
  if (is.na(m[1, 2])) return(NA_character_)
  normalize_id(m[1, 2])
}

extract_fnirs_id <- function(path) {
  m <- str_match(basename(path), "^S(\\d+)_")
  if (is.na(m[1, 2])) return(NA_character_)
  normalize_id(m[1, 2])
}

extract_fnirs_stimulus <- function(path) {
  b <- basename(path)
  b <- sub("^S\\d+_", "", b)
  b <- sub("_postprocessed.*$", "", b)
  str_to_lower(b)
}

extract_eye_stimulus <- function(path) {
  b <- basename(path)
  b <- sub("^\\d+_", "", b)
  b <- sub("\\.csv(\\.gz)?$", "", b)
  str_to_lower(b)
}

# ----------------------------
# Scan folders
# ----------------------------
fnirs_files <- list.files(
  FNIRS_DIR,
  pattern = "\\.csv(\\.gz)?$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

eye_files <- list.files(
  EYE_DIR,
  pattern = "\\.csv(\\.gz)?$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# ----------------------------
# Build lookup tables
# ----------------------------
fnirs_tbl <- data.frame(
  neural_file = fnirs_files,
  subject_id = vapply(fnirs_files, extract_fnirs_id, character(1)),
  stimulus = vapply(fnirs_files, extract_fnirs_stimulus, character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subject_id), !is.na(stimulus))

eye_tbl <- data.frame(
  eye_file = eye_files,
  subject_id = vapply(eye_files, extract_eye_id, character(1)),
  stimulus = vapply(eye_files, extract_eye_stimulus, character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subject_id), !is.na(stimulus))

# ----------------------------
# Match pairs
# ----------------------------
file_pairs <- inner_join(
  eye_tbl,
  fnirs_tbl,
  by = c("subject_id", "stimulus")
) %>%
  select(eye_file, neural_file, subject_id, stimulus)

fwrite(file_pairs, file.path(QC_DIR, "pairs_videos.csv"))
cat("Wrote", nrow(file_pairs), "pairs to pairs_videos.csv\n")

# Optional: unmatched files
unmatched_eye <- anti_join(eye_tbl, fnirs_tbl, by = c("subject_id", "stimulus"))
unmatched_fnirs <- anti_join(fnirs_tbl, eye_tbl, by = c("subject_id", "stimulus"))

fwrite(unmatched_eye, file.path(QC_DIR, "unmatched_eye_videos_files.csv"))
fwrite(unmatched_fnirs, file.path(QC_DIR, "unmatched_fnirs_videos_files.csv"))
```

```{r}
stem <- function(x) sub("\\.csv(\\.gz)?$", "", basename(x), ignore.case = TRUE)
# ----------------------------
# Duration checker
# ----------------------------
check_pair_duration <- function(eye_file, neural_file) {
  eye <- fread(eye_file)
  neu <- fread(neural_file)

  if (!"t_rel_ms" %in% names(eye)) stop("Eye file missing t_rel_ms: ", eye_file)
  if (!"time" %in% names(eye)) stop("Eye file missing time: ", eye_file)
  if (!"time" %in% names(neu)) stop("Neural file missing time: ", neural_file)

  eye_t_rel_s <- eye$t_rel_ms / 1000
  neu_t_s <- neu$time - first(neu$time)
  
  # Duration QC
  eye_dur_s <- max(eye_t_rel_s, na.rm = TRUE) - min(eye_t_rel_s, na.rm = TRUE)
  neu_dur_s <- max(neu_t_s, na.rm = TRUE) - min(neu_t_s, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    eye_file = eye_file,
    neural_file = neural_file,
    eye_n = nrow(eye),
    neural_n = nrow(neu),
    eye_duration_s = eye_dur_s,
    neural_duration_s = neu_dur_s,
    duration_diff_s = eye_dur_s - neu_dur_s,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Sync function
# ----------------------------
sync_pair <- function(eye_file, neural_file, out_dir = OUT_DIR) {
  dir_create(out_dir)

  eye <- fread(eye_file)
  neu <- fread(neural_file)

  # Eye-tracking time in seconds
  if (!"t_rel_ms" %in% names(eye)) stop("Eye file missing t_rel_ms")
  # Downsample 1000 Hz to seconds
  eye <- eye %>% mutate(t_rel_s = t_rel_ms / 1000)

  # Neural time rebased to 0
  if (!"time" %in% names(neu)) stop("Neural file missing time")
  neu <- neu %>% mutate(t_rel_s = time - first(time))

  # Neural bin width
  # Sampling interval: 0.1024 seconds
  # Sampling rate: 9.765625 Hz
  dt <- median(diff(neu$t_rel_s), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Build one bin per neural row 
  breaks <- c(neu$t_rel_s, tail(neu$t_rel_s, 1) + dt)

  # Assign each eye sample to a neural bin
  # Downsampling 1000 Hz to 9.765625 Hz
  eye$bin <- cut(
    eye$t_rel_s,
    breaks = breaks,
    labels = FALSE,
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = FALSE
  )

  # Summarize eye data within each neural bin
  eye_sum <- eye %>%
    filter(!is.na(bin)) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(
      eye_n = n(),
      xp = mean(xp, na.rm = TRUE),
      yp = mean(yp, na.rm = TRUE),
      ps = mean(ps, na.rm = TRUE),
      xpl_i = mean(xpl_i, na.rm = TRUE),
      xpr_i = mean(xpr_i, na.rm = TRUE),
      ypl_i = mean(ypl_i, na.rm = TRUE),
      ypr_i = mean(ypr_i, na.rm = TRUE),
      psl_i = mean(psl_i, na.rm = TRUE),
      psr_i = mean(psr_i, na.rm = TRUE),
      blink_prop = mean(blink_L | blink_R, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(row = bin)

  # Join summaries back to neural rows
  out <- neu %>%
    mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
    left_join(eye_sum, by = "row") %>%
    select(-row)

  out_file <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(stem(neural_file), "_eye_synced.csv")
  )

  fwrite(out, out_file)
  message("Wrote: ", out_file)
}

# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
pairs <- fread(file.path(QC_DIR, "pairs_videos.csv"))

# 1) duration summary first
duration_summary <- rbindlist(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
    cat("\nChecking pair:", i, "\n")
    res <- check_pair_duration(pairs$eye_file[i], pairs$neural_file[i])
    #print(res)
    #res
  }),
  fill = TRUE
)

fwrite(duration_summary, file.path(QC_DIR, "duration_summary_videos.csv"))
cat("\nWrote onset/duration summary to duration_summary_videos.csv\n")

# 2) then sync
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
  sync_pair(pairs$eye_file[i], pairs$neural_file[i])
}
```

# Synchronize SART data
```{r}
# ----------------------------
# Paths
# ----------------------------
ROOT_DIR <- "/Users/evansalvarez/Eye-tracking-Loneliness-Mindwandering-ELM-/data"
FNIRS_DIR <- file.path(ROOT_DIR, "processed/fNIRS_processed_SART/hbo_hbr_csv")
EYE_DIR   <- file.path(ROOT_DIR, "processed/eye_processed_SART")
QC_DIR    <- file.path(ROOT_DIR, "qc/sync")
OUT_DIR   <- file.path(ROOT_DIR, "processed/eye_sync_fNIRS_SART")

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
normalize_id <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%02d", as.integer(x))
}

extract_eye_id <- function(path) {
  m <- str_match(basename(path), "^data_preprocessedSART_(\\d+)_")
  if (is.na(m[1, 2])) return(NA_character_)
  normalize_id(m[1, 2])
}

extract_fnirs_id <- function(path) {
  m <- str_match(basename(path), "^S(\\d+)_")
  if (is.na(m[1, 2])) return(NA_character_)
  normalize_id(m[1, 2])
}

# ----------------------------
# Scan folders
# ----------------------------
fnirs_files <- list.files(
  FNIRS_DIR,
  pattern = "\\.csv(\\.gz)?$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

eye_files <- list.files(
  EYE_DIR,
  pattern = "\\.csv(\\.gz)?$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# ----------------------------
# Build lookup tables
# ----------------------------
fnirs_tbl <- data.frame(
  neural_file = fnirs_files,
  subject_id  = vapply(fnirs_files, extract_fnirs_id, character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subject_id))

eye_tbl <- data.frame(
  eye_file   = eye_files,
  subject_id = vapply(eye_files, extract_eye_id, character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subject_id))

# ----------------------------
# Match pairs by subject only
# ----------------------------
file_pairs <- inner_join(
  eye_tbl,
  fnirs_tbl,
  by = "subject_id"
) %>%
  select(eye_file, neural_file, subject_id)

dir.create(QC_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
fwrite(file_pairs, file.path(QC_DIR, "pairs_SART.csv"))
cat("Wrote", nrow(file_pairs), "pairs to pairs_SART.csv\n")

# Optional: unmatched files
unmatched_eye   <- anti_join(eye_tbl, fnirs_tbl, by = "subject_id")
unmatched_fnirs <- anti_join(fnirs_tbl, eye_tbl, by = "subject_id")

fwrite(unmatched_eye, file.path(QC_DIR, "unmatched_eye_SART_files.csv"))
fwrite(unmatched_fnirs, file.path(QC_DIR, "unmatched_fnirs_SART_files.csv"))
```
